title: Markaziy Osiyodagi ilk metro 1977 yilda Toshkentda ochilgan
hook: Toshkent metrosi 1977 yilda ochilgan, Markaziy Osiyoda birinchi.

scenes.text: Toshkent metrosi 1977 yil noyabr oyida ochildi va Markaziy Osiyodagi birinchi metro bo'ldi.
U Sovet Ittifoqida Moskva, Leningrad, Kiyev, Tbilisi, Boku va Xarkovdan keyin yettinchi metro edi.
1966 yilgi zilziladan keyin metro zilzilaga chidamli qilib loyihalangan.
Bekatlar marmar, granit va milliy naqshlar bilan bezatilgan.
2018 yilgacha metroda suratga olish taqiqlangan edi.

description:
Toshkent metrosi 1977 yil noyabr oyida ochilgan va Markaziy Osiyodagi birinchi metro bo'lgan. 1966 yilgi zilziladan keyin u zilzilaga chidamli qilib loyihalangan.

Siz buni bilarmidingiz? Izohda "ha" yoki "yo'q" deb yozing.
source: Fact-check 2026-11-12 (web search). Opened November 1977 (most sources give 6 Nov, Aramco World gives 7 Nov, so the day was dropped to stay safe); first metro in Central Asia; Lonely Planet and Wikipedia-derived pages call it the seventh in the USSR; Kharkiv opened 22-23 Aug 1975 and was the sixth, with Moscow, Leningrad, Kyiv, Tbilisi and Baku before it. Built after the 1966 earthquake with seismic design, stations in marble, granite and national motifs. Photography was banned until June 2018 (RFE/RL, Lonely Planet; some outlets say July 2018) because the metro doubled as a bomb shelter, so '2018 yilgacha' is correct. Tbilisi 1966 and Baku 1967 openings were not shown in search results (kept from general knowledge, order is consistent with the list). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tashkent_Metro ; https://aramcoworld.com/articles/2020/tashkents-underground-masterpieces ; https://www.rferl.org/a/uzbekistan-s-secret-underground-a-ban-on-photography-is-lifted-on-tashkent-metro-/29437456.html ; https://www.lonelyplanet.com/news/uzbekistan-underground-inside-tashkents-ornate-soviet-metro ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kharkiv_Metro
